title: Do Electric Cars Catch Fire More Often? The Data 🔥🔋 #shorts

scenes.text: Electric cars catch fire all the time, right? The data says no.
Sweden tracks car fires by fuel type. In 2022, about zero point zero zero four percent of its electric cars burned.
For gas and diesel cars, it was zero point zero eight percent. Roughly twenty times higher, though that total includes arson.
So why the scary headlines? When one battery cell is damaged, it overheats and heats its neighbors. That chain reaction is called thermal runaway.
It makes EV fires rare but stubborn. One crash fire in Texas took more than thirty thousand gallons of water.
Dramatic events feel common because they make the news. What else do we misjudge that way? Follow EV Drive for daily car tech.
